message: ingress-nginx answers plain HTTP requests for 1 path(s) on this host with a 308 redirect to HTTPS. The Gateway needs an HTTP listener with a redirecting HTTPRoute to do the same.

fix.summary: Attach a redirect-only HTTPRoute to the HTTP listener for this host.
fix.snippet:
rules:
- filters:
  - type: RequestRedirect
    requestRedirect:
      scheme: https
      statusCode: 308
